tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dus gsum mkhyen pa seng ge sgra'i rnam par thar pa'o//

na mo gu ru/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor 'das gnyis med 'od gsal thugs// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med cing*// sprul skus 'gro don rdzogs mdzad pa// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la 'dud// tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs sku gsum lhun gyis grub// snang stong dbyer med chos sku'i ngang la bzhugs// bde chen spros bral 'od gsal rgyun chad med// dus gsum shes bya rdo rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// sprul pa du mas 'gro rnams smin mdzad pa// 'phrin las mthar phyin bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// chos rje rin chen rnam thar dpag med las// bdag 'dra rmongs pas brjod par mi nus kyang*// rje btsun nyid kyi gsung dang gzhan snang las// gdul bya dad phyir che long tsam gcig brjod// 'o skol gyi chos rje rin po che/ bla ma lha rje'i thugs kyi sras su gyur pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de/ yul tre shod gangs kyi ra ba/ spo chu lha ldong dkar por sku 'khrungs nas/ de yang shin tu skyed che la sku shed dang ldan ba'i gang zag gcig byung bar gda'/ de nas dgung lo drug lon pa'i dus su mdo smad khams kyi byang rgya la bzhud nas tshong dus shing kun du byon nas/ dgung lo bdun la rang yul du byon/ dgung lo brgyad lon pa'i dus su lho rgya la bzhud nas tshong dus ba yan du byon nas/ yab gdan drangs pa yin gsungs/ de nas lo bcu gcig lon pa'i dus na/ dpal lha mo bsgrub pas zhal mthong zhing dgra btul nas/ sngar shākya seng ge'i bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan lo lnga brgya phrag bcu gnas pa'i dus 'dir/ gzhan don bya bar dgongs nas dgung lo bcu drug la/ tre ska brag dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i chos 'khor chen po der/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gi bla ma'i spyan sngar rab tu byung nas/ mtshan chos kyi grags pa zhes bya bar btags nas/

lo gnyis mkhan po'i zhabs tog mdzad/ dge bshes bkra ra ba la bde mchog gi dbang skur zhus nas/ mi g.yo ba dang*/ bka' gdams kyi chos gsan no// de nas dgung lo bcu dgu la thos bsam la yul dbus su byon nas/ nyi shu la stod lung yul thang du slebs/ dge bshes rgya dmar dang phya pa la/ shar gsum dang byams chos gsan/ de nas 'phan yul du byon nas/ dge bshes pa tshab lo tsa ba la/ rigs tshogs gsan/ de nas dge bshes sa yug pa la/ bsnyen rdzogs mdzad nas 'dul ba gsan/ de nas stag dur du byon nas lo lngar bka' gdams mdzad/ ra ljags ston tshul la/ dgyes rdor gyi rgyud dang*/ bde mchog dang*/ ma ha ma ya dang*/ lam 'bras la sogs pa dang*/ brag dgar ba la rdzogs chen a ro'i snyan rgyud gsan no// dgung lo sum cu la/ dge bshes sha ba gling pa'i spyan sngar slob dpon sgom tshul dang mjal/ de nas bla ma lha rje'i spyan sngar byon pa la/ dang po zla ba gnyis tsam du mjal du ma gnang*/ mjal dus su dar bcu tsam phul nas gdam ngag zhus pas/ lam rim tho re ba gcig gsungs nas ngas kyang de bsgoms pa yin/ khyod rang yang de sgoms gsungs/ zhu sna dang bdag 'dzin thams cad slob dpon sgom pas byas/ de nas chos rje la dbang bskur zhus/ thabs lam gyi gdams ngag gnang nas/ bsgoms pas zhag dgu nas drod che bar byung nas gos kyang rkyang pa byas nas zla ba dgu bsgoms/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod zangs rir bsgom du song gsungs nas/ dbyar zla gsum zangs rir bzhugs pas/ sems gnas pa ci byar nyan pa dang lhag mthong sprin bar gyi nyi ma lta bu byung ba dang*/ bla ma la phyag skyel du byon nas/ sgam por lo gsum dka' thub drag po mdzad nas bsgoms pas/ gra pa brgyad brgya'i nang nas bsgom sran che bar grags/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod 'ol kar bsgom du song gsungs nas/ der 'ol ka'i bri bu ri bo cher brag phug gcig tu bsgoms tsam na/ bud med gcig byung nas/

khyod 'dir ma 'dug /nga'i ma jo 'ong zer/ der brag srin yin bar dgongs nas/ byams snying rje bsgoms gsungs/ der zla ba bcu bzhi bsgrub pas nges shes khyad par can du thugs la 'khrungs/ lam rtags ngo mtshar can mang po byung*/ shin tu dga' nas phyag skyel ba dang dri rtogs mdzad du bya rkog dgon par bla ma'i spyan sngar byon nas zhus pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ a na ho/ khams pa se bo khyod la nga re che ba yin ba la/ khyod kyis ni nor nas 'dug pas da lta bsgoms/ nor sa ni med 'dug pa la dgongs nas zla ba drug sgam po rang du bsgoms pa la/ skyed ye ma byung*/ yang bla ma la zhus pas/ ngo bo la skyon 'ong rgyu ni mi 'dug /nor yang rang gi de bsgoms yin zhus pa la/ bla ma dgyes nas bu 'khor ba dang 'brel chod pa de rang yin gsungs nas/ gnas lugs don gyi ngo sprod mdzad/ rjes su bstan pa'i gdams ngag gsungs/ yang rje btsun gyis/ khyod gtsang phyogs su ldom bu la song gsungs nas/ gtsang la stod man chad du ldom bu la phyin/ bla ma mi la'i slob ma 'ga' re dang mjal/ dge tshul spun gnyis la phyag rgya chen po rde'u skor zhus/ don mo rir byon nas don mo'i ri pa la zhus/ spen phug pa la bde mchog gi dbang bskur dang*/ jo bo rje'i gdams ngag mang du zhus/ rgya mo yang khang ba la brtag gnyis gdams bshad zhus/ de nas mar 'ongs nas 'phan yul bya bzang brag la dbyar dgun gsum 'dag char byas nas/ gtum mo'i yon tan dpag tu med pa byung bas/ blo bde ba'i mgur bzhengs/ mtshan bla ma grags par grags/ gzhan snang la ri brag la mi thogs par 'dug zer ba'ang 'byung gsungs/ de nas rje btsun la phyag 'tshal du 'ongs nas/ sgam por zla ba 'ga' bzhugs/ yang rje btsun gyis khyod mon du sgom du song gsungs nas/ tsha bre lnga khyer nas mon gyi rgyal po ga chung gi rtsar byon/ de'i btsun mo bod mo gcig gis pha ming smos pas lo tsa byas te/

tsha rgyal po la zhal mthong byas/ bla mas rgyal po'i mchod gnas mdzad nas/ mon gyi ri la bzhugs/ brgyags zad nas len 'ongs pa'i lam kar nags gseb nas stag gcig byung ba dang*/ bla ma pha bong gcig gi steng du bzhugs pas stag des skor ba byas/ 'tshe ba mi byed par dgongs nas/ mar byon ba'i lam ka ru bud med gnyis kyis sku ba phyed brag gcig chang gis bkangs nas drangs/ rgyal po'i pho brang du byon nas brgyags blangs nas yar 'ongs pas ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mon bod 'tshams dper byas pa'i mgur bzhengs/ 'phyis rgyal pos ras kyi dog pa 'ga' dang dug sngags gcig rdzong ba byas ste tshur byon/ lam du bla ma ras chung ba'i drung du zhag bzhi bcu bsdad nas thun 'jogs dang*/ chos drug zhus/ nā ro pa'i gdam ngag gi dri rtogs legs par byas gsungs/ de nas dwags por byon nas bla ma dang mjal dus su/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod la stag gis skor ba byas yang gsungs/ de ltar byas zhus pa la/ stag de mkha' 'gro ma'i sprul pa yin/ bud med gnyis kyis btung ba drangs pa yang*/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro mas dngos grub ster ba yin gsungs/ der lo gcig bzhugs/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyod gangs kar la song gsungs nas der byon nas/ slob dpon pad ma'i dgon pa pha 'ong dkar leb kyi zhabs su/ dbyar bcud len mdzad cing bzhugs pas kyang mkha' 'gro mas 'tsho ba drangs/ yon tan rin po che du ma rgyud la skyes/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes byung nas/ nga rang ngan gyi mgur bzhengs pa yin gsungs/ lar mos gus med na rgyud la yon tan mi 'byung*/ nges de phyis chad bla ma la tha mal gyi 'du shes 'byung ma myong gsungs// de nas ston kar phyin tsam na/ snyi mo nyi drung gi 'phrang gcig na mar 'ongs tsam na/ rdzings kha gcig na khang pa'i tsar bud med bzhi thags 'thag cing snang*/ cig gis jo bo dro gsol ba byas/

gcig nang du song nas yar byon zer/ phyir la khyer la shog byas pas/ cang mi nyes nang du byon zer/ phyin tsa na bud med bzhi ka nang du snang*/ sku ba phyed pa thod phor 'dra ba gcig gi nang du bza' btung drangs pa la/ phyag tshang bud med de'i the 'ong gnyis la bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis yum dang bcas pa gcig zhal gzigs bza' btung de mi'i sor 'dzug gi tshod mar 'dugs/ the tshom med par gsol ba la/ ro mchog brgya dang ldan bar byung gsung*/ yang bud med des phor pa de nam mkha' la zed tsam na/ 'o ma'am chu skya 'dra bas gang ba drangs pa gsol nas/ sgor byon tsam na bud med bzhi ka sgo na thags 'thag cing snang*/ der mar byon ba'i lam du sa gzhi dar gyi 'bol ltar 'jam pa dang*/ sku mchog ras bal ltar yang ba dang*/ yid ni ngos bzung med par dga' ba byung gsungs/ de nas gzhu snying gnyis kyi bar na/ rdzong ces bya ba'i dgon pa na sgom ma gcig phyugs 'tsho ba dang 'phrad/ ya ki dgon pa na su bzhugs dris pas/ nga'i slob dpon bzhugs zer/ 'o na mjal bar zhu byas pas/ da 'tshams byas pa mi mjal zer/ cis kyang mjal bar zhu byas pas/ ngas bla ma la zhu yis zer nas song ba dang*/ yar byon zer/ nang du byon tsam na btsun rgan pho mo gnyis snang*/ phyag byas pa la phyag ma byed btsun rgan pho mo la ltos gsungs/ yang phyag legs par 'tshal gsungs// de nas ja gral du bla ma rdzong pa'i zhal nas/ khyed la de ring bud med bzhis chos ston 'tsho ba drangs ang gsungs/ drangs byas pas bla ma rdzong pa'i zhal nas/ de kun mkha' 'gro ma yin/ tshod ma'i rgyu de bal yul cha ting na/ khyi bdag a sho ka bya ba'i bu dha rma si ti bya ba shi nas/ ro tar ti ta'i dur khrod du bskyal ba mkha' 'gro mas blangs pa yin gsungs/ da lta de na yod dam dris pas/ da de na med/ kha che'i grong khyer sam pa ta bya ba'i dur khrod na/ zla ba nag po'i nyi shu lnga la mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba'i dus yin pas/

tshogs mchod la der song zin/ mkha' 'gro mas khyed la dngos grub ster ba yin/ mon gyi lam du bud med gnyis kyis btung ba drangs pa yang mkha' 'gro ma yin gsungs/ rin po che'i thugs la khong gi dgon pa de bla ma'i phar tsang dgon pa 'dra snyam tsam na/ bla ma rdzong pa'i zhal nas khyod kyi bla ma'i phar rtsang dgon pa de 'dra yang gsungs/ bla mas bsam mno byed ma spobs gsungs/ de la sogs pa'i blo mang du gsungs/ khyod kyis bla ma lha rjes ci gsungs gyis gsungs/ de nas khong la phyag rgya chen po thog bab dang gdams ngag mang du zhus nas/ de nas dwags por phyag 'tshal du byon tsam na/ grol sgom dang khams pa se bo gnyis sdod gsungs nas/ de nub nyams dga' ba'i bla bo mang du gsungs/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyod la de dang de 'dra ba'i mkhyen pa'i bla ma yod dam gsungs/ yod zhus pas/ de bla ma nā ro pa'i sum slob yin gsungs/ sngar mkha' 'gro mas 'tsho ba drangs pa la sogs pa rnams ci lta ba bzhin du bla mas mkhyen nas tshur gsung bas phar la zhu ma dgos/ zhus pas rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga'i bla ma nyid la de zad par me'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i dus su ngas me'i sna ma brten nas bros/ chu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs dus su/ ngas chu lting gcig tu mthong*/ de la sogs pa zad par gyi yon tan thams cad mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' yang khong la brlom pa rdul tsam yang med/ spyir sgom chen pa yon tan la rlom ba skyer mi rung ngo gsungs nas gdam ngag ma lus par gnang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga kam po gnas nang du 'gro dgos byas tsam na/ zhabs bsnyung bas 'gror ma btub pa yin/ da khyod song dang gzhan la phan thogs par 'dug gsungs/ zang zlum du slob dpon sgom pa ba la phyag bskyal bas kyang de rnams mkhyen nas tshur gsungs/ de nas yar byon nas gzhu smad kyi lha ri rgyal po la dbyar zla gsum bzhugs dus su/

e ma phung po dur khrod kyi mgur bzhengs/ de'i dgun nas gzhu'i gru bzhi dgon pa bzung ba la bud med gcig gis 'tsho ba drangs/ mkha' 'gro ma yin bar 'dug /'tsho ba brang breng tsam las ma byung*/ lar ngas bsgrub pa byas pa'i dus na/ lto gos 'dzom po ma byung yang bsgrub pa la thang lhod shor ma myong*/ nga'i dka' slas tsam sus kyang mi nus/ lto rgyab la gyong skur mi nus par dang po nas 'dzoms po 'dod pa la chos mi dgos pa'ang mi 'ong gsung*/ de'i tshe bla ma bai ro la dbang dang byin rlabs zhus nas/ bde mchog lhan skyes dang rje btsun u rgyan ma dang*/ te lo'i dho ha dang*/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa la sogs pa mang du zhus/ bla ma dpal la bde mchog gi dbang bskur zhus nas gdam ngag mang du gsan/ spyir dbus gtsang na lo sum cu bzhugs te lo bcur thos bsam dang*/ lo bcu gnyis bsgrub pa mdzad pa la/ lag pa rdul dang bral ma myongs gsungs/ lo brgyad du gzhur bzhugs/ 'tshogs pa bzhi bcu tsam byung*/ skal ldan mang rab la phan thogs/ yo byad ci byung yang 'phral dgos ma gtogs pa bla ma rnams gnyis la 'bul ba byas gsungs/ de'i tshe slob dpon sgom pa lha lung na gra pa sum brgya tsam dang bzhugs pa la/ rta khrab 'ga' khyer nas khams su bzhud pa'i phyi phyag la byon bas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ nga yang thang gcig gnas nang na chas pa yin pa la rkang pa na bas ma rtol ba yin/ bla ma'i bka' yin pas lan gcig song la/ bza' ma rnyed pa'am/ g.yeng ba che nas dge sbyor ma dmar na yar shog gsungs nas/ nga 'chi gsung bas der bshums pas/ bla bo bshad kyis nyon dang gsungs nas sngar bsgrub pa mdzad pa dang*/ da lta chos thams cad sgyu mar shes pa dang*/ rdo rje gdan skad gcig la lta nus pa la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba dang*/ de la sogs te yon tan rgya chen po mnga' yang*/ brlom pa'am nga rgyal rdul tsam yang med gsungs/

grub bzhir bzhugs dus su khams su 'gro snyam tshe kam po'i rdo rje dpal brtsegs bsu ba la phyin ba gzhu'i dge bsnyen gyis bkag pas ma khegs gsung ngo*/ de nas bzhi 'go ba'i tshong dpon rin dpal gyis gdan 'dren byas nas 'phan yul du byon tsam na tre bos 'gro ma ster/ de'i dus su bla ma phag mo grub pas btsun pa ye 'od la 'phrin bskur nas/ khyed khams su ma bzhugs/ dbang bskur dang rab gnas mang po byed zer ba de tsam ma mdzad sku tshe la bar chad 'ong dogs yod gsungs/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ khong nga la thugs brtse ba yin te/ gzhon lnga med par 'brog tu mi 'gro/ de tsam yi tshod med par rab gnas dang dbang bskur mi byed/ ngas bla ma mi la'i sku tshe tsam gcig thub pa yin gsungs/ der tshur log nas mtshur gyi ngos bzang dgon par bzhugs/ yang kol ti ba'i 'gron po go btsun yon bdag gis gdan 'dren byas nas 'phan yul du byon pa la/ yang tri bo'i 'gron pos 'gro ma ster/ der gzhu na tshur log nas slob dpon sgom pa'i snying po se ru na bzhugs pa la rta bzang po gcig dang 'bul ba 'ga' khyer nas phyag la byon/ de nas tre bos gdan 'dren byas nas/ dgung lo lnga bcu la khams su bzhud/ zla stod kyi mkhar ser du lo gnyis bzhugs/ skal ldan 'ga' re la phan thogs/ slob dpon sgom pa la 'bul ba yang bskur/ tre bzhud lo gnyis bzhugs/ skal ldan 'ga'i don mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga la kam po gnas nang du byon/ 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs/ sgom chen rtogs ldan mang po byung*/ dag snang ngo mtshar can yang mang po'ang gzigs/ gzhan snang ngo mtshar can mang po yang byung*/ lo lnga na ja mdzo lnga bcu la sogs pa'i 'bul ba gdan sar bskur/ dgung lo drug bcu rtsa bdun la sku khams drag tu bsnyus ba la/ nye gnas kun kyis gra pa thams cad bsdus nas/ bla ma ni gshegs dogs yod par 'dug da ci bya zer ba la dge 'dun gros byas nas bla ma stag de'u ba dang gra pa rgan po bcu zhu ba phul bas/

rin po che'i sku bsnyung nad 'di la gra pas rim 'gro ci byas kyang sman bar ma byung bas/ da bla ma nyid kyis tshogs sog gcig mdzad par zhu zhes zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis nga 'chi bsams ste/ nga da lta mi 'chi/ bla ma mi la'i sku tshe tsam gcig thub bsam ba yin/ de la rkyen glo bur pa yang mi 'ong snyam pa yin/ tshogs sog ni byas pas chog /gsungs nas gdan sar g.yu bdun bsngos pa la sogs te tshogs sogs byas pas sku khams kyang de rang nas bde bar gyur to// de nas dbus su bzhud par dgongs pa la/ dge 'dun kun zhu ba drag pas lo mang du 'gor ro// ska brag gi dge bshes tshul khrims mchog gis btsun pa gcig la 'phran yig gnyis bskur/ khong gi 'phrin yig la/ bla ma thang gcig trer byon nga dang ni mjal ste mi 'ong ste/ cis kyang 'byon bar zhu zer ba dang gcig /a tsa ra gcig rgya gar nas mar song ba gcig dang tong kun nas shar rgyar yar 'ongs pas rgya yig gcig bzungs nas 'di bla ma de la gtod zer ba gcig dang gnyis bzungs nas byung*/ rgya yig 'di yi don ngas shes gsungs/ de nas bzhud ches mdzad pa la dge 'dun gyi ci ltar bshol btabs kyang ma gnangs nas dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bzhi la 'bri klung na yar byon/ ltong dgrar dbyar bzhugs/ 'bri dam pa chos phyug gi dge 'dun thams cad der byon/ smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ de nas trer byon pa rang gis 'khrug pa thams cad ngo bo nyid kyi zhi nas yul mi thams cad bde bar gyur to// dge bshes tshul khrims mchog 'das zin nas ma mjal/ trer lo gnyis bzhugs 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs/ gdan sar g.yu chen bdun ja sum cu'i 'bul ba bskur/ de nas 'bri klong gi ce bar byon nas bzhugs/ gdul bya thams cad der 'tshogs/ rab tu byung ba stong re tsam byung ba smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ zla smad du byon nas sleb tu kar mar dgon pa mdzad/

'gro ba mang po la phan thogs/ gdul bya thams cad smin par mdzad/ mi mthun ba rnams bsdums/ btson thams cad bkrol/ gser 'bum gcig dang g.yu dngul 'ga' gdan sar 'bul ba bskur/ de nas 'gro don mdzad cing lho rgyud du shul phyungs nas/ dbus su byon nas/ gdan sar gser 'bum tshar bzhi/ mdo mang tshar gcig /spyir gser gyi glegs bam brgya dang bcu/ g.yu chen bcu/ mdzo rta lnga bcu la sogs pa'i 'bul ba byas/ jo bo yi ge drug pa dang*/ jo bo shākya rnam gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i dbus rtsang gi sde dgon rnams la/ rta bdun cu spyir sna chen brgya lhag gi tshogs sogs mdzad/ de nas stod lung mtshur phur gdan sa phabs/ mtshal pa dang rga bar dang 'khrugs pa thams cad bsdums/ yul mi rnams bde bar byas/ bod yul yi gdul bya ma lus pa der 'tshogs te thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad do// rin po che'i rnam par thar pa bsdus pa las/ ci ltar dka' ba spyad cing*/ mkha' 'gro mas 'tsho ba drangs pa dang*/ mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ rje rin bo ches thog mar sgam por byon ba dang*/ sha ba gling pa'i spyan sngar slob dpon sgom pa dang mjal dus su/ sgrol ma dkar mo gcig tu gzigs/ de bla ma gong mas mkhyen nas tshul snying bskyed rim la brtan ba yin gsungs/ de nas chos rje la zab mo'i dbang bskur zhus dus su/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje brjid pa'i sku nyid 'od kyi ra bar bzhugs pa gcig tu gzigs gsungs/ yang grogs mched bzhi yis slob dpon sgom pa la dbang bskur zhus dus na/ slob dpon la grogs mched mthong snang mthun par he ru kar gzigs nas bla ma la zhus pas/ he ru ka ni nga nyid yin gsungs/ slob dpon sgom pa la gzigs pa drug /dgyes rdor du gzigs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'od phung gcig tu gzigs gsungs/ rin po che gru bzhi dgon pa na bzhugs dus su/

chos rje sku yal ba thos nas bzhud pas pho rog rdzong chung dgon par/ slob dpon sgom pa dang slob dpon 'phags pa rnam gnyis dang mjal nas/ slob dpon sgom pa'i na bza' la 'jus nas/ spyan chab byung ba la rje btsun gong mas khong gi gdung ba bsal ba'i phyir/ 'ja' tshon gyi rnam par nam mkha' la gzugs skur wal gyis byon par dpon slob gsum kas mthong snang mthun nas/ phyag 'tshal ba dang de nyid du yal gsungs/ gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ bde chung sangs rgyas zer ba'i slob ma gcig lho stod de na ldom bu la song bas/ dwags la sgam por bla ma'i gdan sa zhig zer ba thos nas byung ba la/ rin po ches dgongs pa mdzad nas gzigs pas/ dang por dwags po gsal bar byung*/ de nas bal yul gsal/ de nas steng 'og thams cad gsal bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po gzigs pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas gdan sa zhig pa mi bden par 'dug gsungs/ ci tsug lags zhus pas/ ngas da ltar bltas pas mthong gsungs nas khong gis de ltar gsung ngo*// yang gnas nang na bzhugs dus su// khyi'i lo 'das mchod kyi rting la/ nam mkha' la shākya thub pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ khyad par du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu stong spyan stong ma dpa' mo sum cu rtsa drug gis bskor ba gzigs pa'i zhal nas/ 'di na he ru ka dpal rgyu// sems ni dri ma med par 'dod// dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni// phag mo'i gzugs su byung ba yin// ces gsungs ba gsan skad/ gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ ston zla ra ba'i nya la bla ma'i 'das mchod byed dus su/ phyed yol na/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon gdugs dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'dra ba mang po byung ba'i nang du/ bla ma lha rje dang*/ nye gnas legs mdzes grags mdzes gnyis dang gtso 'khor du bzhugs nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu gnyis su med pa lta ba'i don// yengs pa med pa bsgom ba'i don// zung du 'jug pa spyod pa'i don// de gsum dbyer med 'bras bu'i don// ces gsungs skad/

yang bla ma rang gi sku 'bag gcig dang*/ dgyes rdor gyi sku 'bag gcig dang*/ rabs gnas zhus pa la/ rten 'brel bzlo ba'i skabs su sgrol ma'i bstod pa gyis gsungs/ phyis ci ltar lags zhus pa la/ sgrol ma lha sku gnyis byon nas thang ka gnyis la thim gsungs/ yang yon bdag skya dgon pa lha gang gi rab gnas zhus la bzhud pa'i lam du/ dpal ldan ma zhal gzigs rab gnas mdzad dus su/ nam mkha' la dha ma ru dang a li ka li yi sgra gsan/ yar bltas pas nam mkha' la lha tshogs dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs te sgra gsan pa ni/ lta bsgom nam mkha' chu dang mtshungs// spyod pa dgag med bsgrub tu med// de gsum dbyer med gnyug ma yin// kun rdzob pi wang sgra dang mtshungs// de don de nyid dbyer med yin// ces gsungs pa gsan skad/ yang yul der dgyes rdor gyi rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa gcig dang bar do yi gdams pa gsan gsungs/ yang gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ gangs ri chen po gcig gi stengs na sprin nag po gcig byung ba'i nang na gri gug dpag tu med pa 'tshub pa'i nang du/ chos skyong mgon po zhal gzigs gsungs/ spyir lha tshogs ci tsam gzigs zhus pa la/ 'di tsam yi grangs med de/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas sum cu rtsa lnga 'od zer can dang*/ khros ma nag mo/ dgyes rdor kyi dkyil 'khor/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor/ sgra nag gi lha tshogs/ 'jig byed kyi lha tshogs/ tshogs 'khor gcig gi dus su yang*/ sgyu ma chen mo lnga/ rje btsun ma lha lnga/ 'dir sgrol ma dkar mo dang*/ gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ mi g.yo ba dang bdag med ma zhal sbyor dang*/ mi g.yo ba la sgrol ma sngon mos yum byas pa gzigs/ dgyes rdor lhan skyes/ gru bzhir bde mchog lhan skyes/ pom phug ru bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lha rgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ bdag med mas yum byas pa zhal gzigs/ yang dus tshod gcig tu lho phyogs dpal kyi ri i kha la/

rdo rje rnal sbyor ma gcer bur 'dug pa/ skra grol ba/ bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ thod pa dang gri gug bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon pa'i gru mo'i nang du zhabs g.yas pa bcug pa/ rgyan med pa gcig gzigs gsungs/ yang dus tshod gcig tu nam mkha' la a li ka li mang po byung de'i rjes la bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i zhal gzigs/ yang nam mkha' la rin po che sing ga gling gi dur khrod du byon pas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa dang mjal nas gsol ba thob gsungs/ yang 'das mchod kyi rting la rin po che nyid rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ma he rgyu ba'i tshal na slob dpon sgom pa dang mjal/ slob dpon kyi zhal nas/ khyod 'dir 'ong ba'i nus pa yod gsan am gsungs nas/ gdams ngag dang bla'o mang du gsan gsung*/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas kyang dus tshod gcig dus mi mtshungs pa'i sngon gyi bram ze chen po la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'ga' dang*/ bla ma mi la dang*/ bla ma lha rje la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma 'ga'/ de la sogs te grub thob gong ma rnams dang mjal ba dang*/ lha tshogs dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs pa ni brjod kyis mi langs pa'o// rin po che'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa las/ dag snang gi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ rin po che sgam por bzhugs dus su/ rmang lam 'byongs pas chos thams cad sgyu ma'i rmi lam tsam du gzigs/ de'i dus su rmang lam du bla ma lha rje byon te/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod mngon dga'i 'pho ba gyis gsungs/ de tshe rin po ches dgyes rdor lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sgyu ma tsam du nam mkha' la sprul nas bla ma nyid kyang dgyes rdor lha dgu byas nas nam mkha' la sprul pa'i thugs kar thim bar byas/ tso'u ri la sogs lha mo brgyad kyang dza zhes brjod pas bdag la bsdus nas nam mkha' la yal bar byas pas/ bla ma lha rje dgyes nas/ mthun 'gyur gnang gsungs/

yang dus tshod gcig tu rin po che rmang lam du kha che'i grong khyer trig brtan gzigs par bzhed nas sku brgya stong du mar sprul nas ngang pa seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas/ trig brtan gyi steng du byon pa'i tshe/ shod nas skye ba med pa'i sgra snyan lhang lhang brjod pa thos gsungs/ yang rmang lam du lan gcig tong kun lta bar 'dod pa dang sing tshang mkhar du slebs tsam na/ dge bshes shes rab bla ma phyug po'i bur skyes pas ngo shes sam mi shes snyam tsam na/ kho dgod pa dang dga' ba'i rtags shes par 'dug gsungs/ yang rmang lam du brag rtsegs ma brgya'i kha la bla ma bde ba'am nyams kyis bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma rus pa'i rgyan can brgyad kyis me tog gi 'phreng ba phyag tu phul bas rin po che nam mkha' la gtor bas/ rin po che pad brtsegs kham par gyur gsungs/ der 'phur nas rta dang seng ge sprul nas zhon te phyin gsungs/ yang rin po che byang lam na mar byon dus su/ nub gcig gi rmang lam na bud med tshon mo gcig gi ro snyed nas/ bshas pa la/ rtsib tsa na dha ma ru mang po byung ba sgra rang grag tu nam mkha' la thal ba'i zla la rin po che bzhud pas u rgyan du byon pa la/ bud med cig gis 'di yan chad ni ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gling yin/ 'di man chad ni 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gling yin zer nas rjes su bstan pa'i gdam ngag gsan gsungs/ gru bzhir sbrul chen po gcig gis mid pa rmis gsungs// phag ri khar thog babs pa sdig 'dzub byas pas bzlogs// kam por gza' ra hu la phar 'drim ba bzlogs// gnas nang na rmang lam du rgya gar gyi ri bya skyibs na bla ma lha rje thugs dam mdzad cing bzhugs pa dang mjal nas bla ma brdzus skyes lags sam zhus pas brdzus skyes yin gsungs/ slob dpon yod dam med zhus pas/ gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa la slob dpon mi dgos gsungs/ de nas chos zhus pa la/

skyes pa'i yul de yang na chag sdang bral bar nges/ tshul khrims don dang ldan na bde 'gro thob par nges/ thab la nan tan byas na lam de chod par nges/ ma bcos rang sar bzhag na don de rtogs par nges/ ces gsungs skad/ yang rmang lam na dka' thub sku sha dkar po gcig byung nas/ sangs rgyas la chos nyan i 'ong zer ba la/ mar me mdzad dang shākya thub pa ni mi bzhugs dgongs nas/ byams pa yin nam byas pa la yin zer/ nyi ma'i 'od zer gcig byung ba'i steng na bzhud pas dga' ldan du byon/ byams pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i cha byad du bzhugs nas/ dge slong sku mdog dkar po mang po la chos gsung zhing 'dug /khong gis kyang nyan pa la/ 'di la gsal ba ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes pa la sogs pa zab don mang po gsan skad/ grogs po rnams la khyed kyi cir go byas tsam na/ skye ba med par go zer/ ngas kyang der go gsungs skad// yang mtshur phu na nub gcig gi lam du nub phyogs su phar bzhud pa la/ 'ja' tshon gyi gur khang gi nang du/ thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gcig pa bzhugs nas snang bas/ sman gyi ri lu mang po byin na 'di kun gzhan la byin dang phan zer ba rmis gsungs/ yang gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ nub gcig gi rmang lam du/ 'ja' tshon gyi nang du pad ma'i steng du/ rin po che dgyes rdor yab yum du bzhugs pa la/ phyogs brgyad nas dgyes rdor kyi lha mo brgyad kyis ping wang sbreng ba'i zla la/ nub kyi phyogs na bde ba che zhes spyan 'dren du zhu phul/ 'chi rtags yin te zlog pa la tshegs ma byung gsungs/ pom phug tu bzhugs dus su rmang lam du rgya gar nas mkha' 'gro mas shing rta khyer nas bsu ba la byung gsungs/ lan gcig bal yul du bzhud par 'dod tshe/ dgyes rdor gyi lha mo brgyad kyis khyod da rung ma 'gro zhes phyogs thams cad nas spyan phye yang snang gsungs/

rin po che gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ lag sor gyi nya la bla ma'i mchod pa byas/ srod la bla ma la gsol ba btabs pa la/ tho rangs rmang lam du bla ma lha rje byon nas chos gsungs pa mgur du bzhengs pa ni/ kha tsang lag sor nya dus su// rje'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir// gsung la mchod pa byed dus su// srod la rje la gsol ba btabs// tho rangs gnyid kyi rmang lam du// rje btsun mdun du byon pa bsam// rje yi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// rig pa mtha' bral lta bar go /gnyug ma 'gyur med sgom par go /chags med rgyud zhi spyod par go /de gsum dbyer med 'bras bur go /de rang don chos sku yin bar go /de gzhan don 'phrin las 'di ltar mdzod// zhen pa med pa'i sbyin pa thong*// gnod pa med par tshul khrims srungs// khong khro med par bzod pa bsgom// snyom las med par brtson 'grus rtsoms// yengs ba med par bsam gtan sgom// bde chen spros bral shes rab bskyed// de drug 'gro ba'i don du bsngo// ces gsan gsungs/ ༈ mtshur phu na bzhugs dus su/ nub gcig gi rmang lam na/ kha che'i grong khyer du rig gi zhabs na rgya gar gyi mtha' 'khobs gcig tu byon pa la/ rnal 'byor pa dpon g.yog gnyis dang mjal nas/ bla mas khyed su lags dris pas/ in tra bod de yin gsungs/ rin po ches chos zhus pas/ rje btsun ma u rgyan ma'i bsgrub thabs gsungs/ gzhan zab pa gcig kyang zhu byas pas/ rje btsun ma zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma'i bsgrub thabs las kha tshar dang bcas pa gsan gsungs/ phyis mdo bor byi ba lo'i tshes gsum kyi nub mo nam mkha' la/ 'ja' tshon gyi nang na bu med gos dang thod dmar po phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa 'khor bzhis bskor ba gcig na re/ zab mo'i don gar dag dgar ma bshad gsungs// phyis zho brang gi gnas tshes nyi shu la chos 'di yi byin rlabs mdzad pa'i nub mo brag dmar po'i shing gi gseb na/

sngar gyi bu med lnga po khros nas 'dug khyed su yin dris pa la nga ni su yin mi shes na/ rgyal po'i lcam mo legs mo yin/ zab mo'i don gar dag dgar ma bshad gsungs// yang gzhur nyi shu brgyad la bla ma kham lung pa la byin rlabs mdzad pa'i nub mo/ sprin dkar po'i nang na bud med lnga khro zhing zab mo'i don gar dag dgar ma bshad byas pa la mi nyan gsung nas bzhud do// yang mtshur phu na bzhugs dus su byi ba lo'i sbrul zla'i yar tshes gcig gi nub mo rmang lam du// lho nub na gzigs nas bzhugs tsam na/ bar snang na tshur 'brug gcig grag nas bltas pas/ 'od dpung gi nang nas/ rnal 'byor pa dur khrod kyi rgyan kyi brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa cang te'u bsnams pa gcig bzhugs nas/ me tri ba yin gsungs/ de'i zhal nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gnyis su 'dus/ nyon mongs pa can kyi yid dang lhan cig skyes pa'i yid gnyis su 'dus/ nyon mongs pa can kyi yid kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i yid du 'dus/ gsungs nas 'ja' bzhin du yal nas gshegs gsung*// yang sbrul zla'i nyi shu gsum gyi nub mo'i rmang lam na/ 'od dpung nang na rnal 'byor pa phyag g.yas na mda' 'dzin pa bya byed thams cad phyag g.yon pas byed pa gcig gi zhal nas/ nga ni su yin mi shes na/ nga ni sa ra ha par grags/ 'o na gdams ngag zhu zhus pas/ mtha' bzhi dang bral na lta ba yin// yengs pa med na bsgoms pa yin// dgag bsgrub med na spyod pa yin/ spang thob med na 'bras bu yin// gsung nas 'ja' bzhin du yal nas gshegs su gsungs so// zla ba de'i nyi shu gsum gyi nub mo'i rmang lam na/ dwags la sgam por byon tsam na/ bla ma nyid kyi phyag na 'ja' tshon gyi sne mo gcig 'dug pa de bsdog cing bzhud pas sgre'u 'phrang gi yang dgon du byon tsa na bla ma lha rje dang mjal nas/ sngar gyi rmang lam rnams bshad tsam na/ bla ma lha rje'i zhal nas/

chos thams cad rmi lam dang 'ja' tshon tsam du go bar gyis/ gsungs na rnal sad gsungs/ de la sogs pa'i rmang lam ngo mtshar can ni dpag tu med cing brjod kyis mi lang ngo*// rin po che'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa la/ rmang lam gyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che la/ bla ma gong ma rnams 'jig rten gar skyes/ gdul bya mang nyung spyod pa ci mdzad zhus pa la/ bla ma mar pa ni lho phyogs dpal kyi ri la nye ba'i phri na ga ra'i grong khyer na pan ṭi tar sku 'khrungs/ res rnal 'byor pa yang mdzad nas 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad gsungs// bla ma lha rje ni kha che rgya gar gnyis kyi bar na/ rgya gar gyi yul ka rna pa na grong khyer pad ma can du/ zhi ba'i go cha bya bar mtshan thogs/ res dge slong gi cha byad/ res rnal 'byor par mdzad nas spyod pa du mas sems can gyi don mdzad nas/ de na slob ma bzhi bcu tsam skyes nas snang gsungs/ bla ma lha rje la sprul pa gsum yod de/ sprul pa gcig ni nub phyogs bde ba bkod pa'i zhing khams na/ byang chub sems dpa' dri med grags par mtshan thogs pas/ sems can bye ba tsam gyi 'dren pa mdzad gsungs/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten kyi khams mu tig dra bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' dri med zla ba grags zhes bya bar mtshan thogs pas sems can mang po'i don mdzad/ grong khyer pad ma can du bla ma lha rje sku dngos yal nas/ rab 'byams stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ a sho ka zhes bya bar rab tu grags gsungs// slob dpon sgom pa de rgya gar nub phyogs na yul kong ka bya bar sku 'khrungs/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po btul nas/ sems can mang po la phan gsung*/ slob dpon shes rab byang chub/ ri bo bya rkang na bzhugs bsgrubs pa'ang mdzad/ sems can mang po la'ang phan thogs/ bla ma spen phug pa la stod gtsang por sku 'khrungs dga' ba ye shes bya ba mtshan thogs// bla ma dpal chen po byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten kyi khams mu tig dra bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba ni/

sems can mang po'i don mdzad/ slob dpon kra ra ba cog re'i 'bring 'tshams kyi srib ri na sku 'khrungs/ ye shes 'byung gnas grags par mtshan thogs// slob dpon stag dur ba/ 'dzam bu gling gi byang phyogs zad pa na grong khyer bde ldan du sku 'khrungs/ grags pa mtha' yas bya bar mtshan thogs/ sems can bye ba tsam gyi don mdzad/ slob dpon pa tshab lo tsa ba/ grong khyer trig brtan gyi pha rol na// pan ṭi ta rin chen 'byung ldan grags par mtshan thogs/ 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad// bla ma rdzong pa kha che dang nub che'i 'tshams na sku 'khrungs/ sngar gyi phyag rgya mo dang spyod pa mdzad cing sems can mang po'i don mdzad// slob dpon phya pa kha che'i grong khyer trig brtan na paṇ+ḍi tar sku 'khrungs/ bla ma dngul chu ba tong kun rgyal po'i bur skyes/ rmang lam du ri bo rtse lngar zhal mjal/ dge bshes zhu don mo ri pa de/ 'dzam bu gling zad pa'i mtha' ri bo ta la'i rtse mo skur 'khrungs/ chos brda'i sgo nas gsungs/ 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad/ bla ma ras chung ba rgya gar bal po'i bar na skur 'khrungs/ mtshan dar ma pu kar thogs nas spyod pa sna tshogs mdzad/ slob dpon shes rab rdo rje 'phan yul rang na sku 'khrungs/ bka' gdams pa la brten gnas bsgrub pa byed// slob dpon 'phags pa de bal yul pham mthing gi pha rol na sku 'khrungs nas/ rnal 'byor par phyag rgya mo dang ldom bu mdzad/ mkhan po sa phug pa rgya gar shar phyogs na/ pan ṭi tar sku 'khrungs nas 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs gsungs/ bal po'i pha rol rgya gar gyi tshu rol gyi brag gcig na/ dpal ldan nag mo chen mo la sogs pa'i ma mo drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sku rang byung yod pa'i sar slob dpon par ma thang re 'byon bar 'dug /de'i dgos pa ni slob dpon der ma byon na/ ma mo kun kyis sems can la gnod pa byed pa yin par 'dug gsungs/ rin po che'i zhal nas/

byang chub sems dpa' tha ma la pa yi lus kyis sems can gzhan don byed pa mthong gsungs/ de ci tsug lags zhus pas/ rgyal kyi gnas brtan 'dre chung ba de/ dpal phag tshang ba'i skye ba yin/ rgya nag dang*/ bal po na yang*/ de'i skye ba gnyis yod gsungs// me nyag gi rgyal po chen po de/ rnal 'byor pa ma tang gi yi skye ba yin gsungs/ rgyal por skye ba'i dgos pa ci lags zhus pa la/ dgos pa ni yab rgyal po de la phan pa dang*/ rgyal khams de'i mi rnams bsod nams kyi lam la bkod pa dang*/ rgyal po btsa' ba la sogs te/ btson mang po bkrol ba rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gdul byar dgongs pa yin par 'dug gsungs// yang bla ma lha rje'i 'das mchod kyi dus na/ bla ma lha rje'i slob ma bzhis sems can gyi don rlabs po che byas pa mthong nas gad mo gcig shor nas/ dge bshes sher 'bum de ci yin dri/ nub phyogs na gser khung ye shes snying po dang ya zi sngon mo/ shar phyogs na sgom pa nyi mdzes dang*/ dwags po sog sgom gnyis yod gsungs// yang bla ma lha rje'i slob ma rin po che'i yang slob snga shos dge tshul gcig te/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ rgyal po bde spyod bzang po'i drung na byang chubs sems dpa'i spyod pa byed gsung*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ smon lam bla ma khyod 'di nas tshe 'phos nas mkhan po mnga' ris pa'i rig 'dzin thob pa de'i mkhan bur gyur/ sngon yang skye ba bzhir pad ma can du mkhan slob tu gyur/ skye ba 'di dang lngar bar ma chad par khyod rab byung byas gsungs// rin po che gzhu gru bzhir dgon par bzhugs dus su/ yon bdag kyang yin la slo ma yang yin pa'i phya rgan zer ba'i sgom chen gcig shi ba la/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgom ba phya de mdo khams kyi sgang smad na 'dzam yul na skyes zin gsungs/ 'phyis 'dzam yul na byon dus su/ skye bo pho mo mang po gcig phyag 'tshal du byung ba la/

bu tsha gcig gis bla ma mi 'jigs par gzhan gyi phyag rten kun blang zhing bla ma la 'bul ba gcig 'dug /rin po che'i zhal nas phya rgan gyi skye ba 'di yin gsungs/ phyis bu tsha de 'gron po'i zla ba bros nas gnas nang du byung*/ de btsun pa byas gdam ngag bstan bas bsgoms pas bsgoms chen gcig byung ba 'dzam skyes ba gsum par grags so// rin po che gnas nang nas yos bu lo la yar byon nas/ sbas yul sag tir bzhugs dus su// gra pa zha snga btsun pa gcig shi ba la/ grogs po gcig gis zha snga gar skyes zhus pas/ rtsang rong na ram ston dar ma grags kyi bur skyes zin gsungs/ phyis dbus su phyin dus su phag lo la gra pa 'ga' gtsang na bsod snyoms la song bas/ ram ston dar ma grags dris nas de'i grong du phyin pa la/ de la bu lo brgyad pa gcig 'dug pas sngar rin po ches gsung ba'i dus tshod dang lo brtsis pa dang*/ mthun par byung bas grong pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to// shar ba na bzhugs dus su// lcang ma nam mkha' 'bar gyi nu bo shi ba gcig de sum cu rtsa gsum na lha longs spyod can zhi gnas yod pa gcig tu skyes zin gsungs/ de la sogs pa gzhan kyi 'chi 'pho dang*/ skye ba mkhyen pa ni bsam kyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ngo*/ rin po che'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa las/ gzhan kyi 'chi 'pho dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ rin po che ngos bzang dang gru bzhir bzhugs dus su/ tshems las ring srel rdo rje dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ tsha tsha 'dra ba'i dbyibs dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs byon/ gzhan kyi rkyen kyi 'phel ba dang*/ gshegs pa la sogs pa'ang byung*/ khyad par du he ru ka dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ kha sar pa ni gsum byon/ gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ tshems dang phyag gi dpung pa las ring srel dpag tu med pa byung*/ sbas yul stag tir bzhugs dus su/

spyan snyung bas dbu'i rtsa gtar ba'i sku mtshal las/ ring srel dpag tu med pa byon/ 'bri klung gi cer ber na bla ma sku chab 'chag pa'i 'dam pa la mi gnyis kyis tshags byas pa la/ mi gcig gis rmi lam na 'dam pa'i nang na ring srel yod zer ba rmis/ phyi nang 'dam pa chu sigs byas pas ring srel bzhi byon/ de'i gtam rgyud rin po ches gsan nas mi de khrid la shog gsungs nas/ gdam ngag bstan pas dge sbyor bzang po byung*/ gzhan yang smin 'tshams dang phyag zhabs dang zhal mchil kun la/ la las gsol ba btabs nas byon pa dang*/ la la byon nas 'phar nus pa'ang byung*/ snang ba dag pa la dag snang du snang la the tshom can kun kyi log rtogs bsal ba'i phyir yang*/ dag snang sna tshogs byung ngo*// kam po gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ dge bshes gnyis dang gra pa 'gas dbang bskur zhus pa'i cho ga'i skabs su dge bshes cig gis/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mthong nas dge bshes grogs de la bstan// yang 'dzam ston sangs rgyas kyis tshogs mchod kyi gral du/ rin po che bde mchog he ru kar gzigs gsungs/ yang gnas nang du bla ma lha rje'i 'das mchod kyi dus su/ mchod gral du rin po che bzhugs pa la/ dbus pa sgom chen gcig gis thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong sku mdog ser po gcig tu mthong bas/ nam ma langs kyi bar du phyag 'tshal/ sgom chen de'i bsod nams skyes pas bla ma bsam yas par grags so// rin po che 'dzam yul pom phug tu bzhugs dus su/ 'dzam ston gcig gis bla ma la gdams ngag zhus pa'i snang ba la/ rin po che yi ge drug mar mthong ba nas/ yi ge drug pa'i mngon rtogs dang bzlas lung yan chad gsungs pa'i snang ba byung ba dang*/ dad pa thob nas bsgoms pas 'dzam dza ne bsgom bzang zhes grags so/ yang dgon pa der bzhugs dus su/ ston zla ra ba yi nya la bla ma'i 'das mchod byed pa'i gral du/

btsun pa 'gres po gcig gi sna ba la rin po che bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa'i snang ba byung*/ rin po che ku sa smad mdo na byon dus su/ rtsa spyil pa'i gra pa rnams kyis dbang bskur zhus pa'i cho ga'i skabs su/ bla ma lhas rin po che rdo rje 'chang du gzigs gsungs/ de'i nub gnyis pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gzigs/ nub gsum pa la rje btsun chen po tai lo par gzigs gsungs/ rin po che zla stod mkhar sar na byon dus du/ zla stod kyi mi dpon thams cad der 'tshogs/ de dus su mkhar sar pas rab gnas zhus pa la/ rten 'brel bzlo ba'i skabs su der 'tshogs pa thams cad mthong snang mthun bar gdung rten chen po gcig gi bum pa la/ rin po che nyid kyi sku gcig dang*/ shākya thub pa'i sku gcig dang gnyis byon bas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ khyad par du cham phu dpon ring dad pa skyes nas bsgoms pas/ bsgoms byung ba'i phye mar la nas khal brgya phul/ dge 'dun la mang ja gcig drangs// mtshur phu dgon par bzhugs dus su/ rtsang pa tshul sing zer ba'i sgom chen gcig gis/ dbang bskur zhus pa'i snang ba la/ rin po che dgyes rdor zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gzigs pa'i thugs ka nas/ 'od zer byung bas dbang bskur ba'i gra pa ci 'dug la 'od zer gyi sna zug pa'i snang ba 'phyis gnyid ma log gi bar du byung gsungs/ 'bri klung gi be ber bzhugs dus su/ dge 'dun mang po gral mdzad pa'i dbu la rin po che bzhugs pa la/ sngags pa gcig phyag 'tshal bar 'dod pa la/ rin po che ma mthong*/ nye gnas kun kyis bstan yang ma mthong*/ jo bo byang chub kyi bstan yang ma mthong nas/ jo bo byang chub kyi yi mug skyes nas spyan chab byung*/ dge 'dun yon mchod thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to// kar ma na bzhug dus su/ 'dan ma gcig phyag 'tshal 'dod nas yang dgon du 'ongs pa la rin po che ni ma mthong nas bla ma bzhugs dang mchod rten dkar po gcig mthong nas/

phyir log nas song*// sa mdo na bzhugs dus su/ gro lto ston btsun bya ba'i bka' gdams pa gcig gis stag lpags gcig thogs nas phyag 'tshal du 'ongs pa la rin po che ma mthong*/ rogs kun kyis phyag 'tshal khams dri byas kyang ma mthong*/ de nas kyang yun ring min ba ma mthong*/ rin po che gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ gnas nang gi shar phyogs nyi ma bzhi tsam gyi sa tsam na/ 'dzam ston sangs rgyas dgon pa na bzhugs pa'i snang ba la/ rin po che zhabs rjen du byon ba la ston pas phyag 'tshal khams dri byas nas/ gdan bshams pa'i tshe bla ma mi snang bar gyur to// yang sa thag ring ba gcig na/ slob ma gcig nad kyis zugs rngus gdungs nas/ bla ma la gsol ba btabs pa la/ byon nas byin rlabs mdzad pas nad pa'i sdug bsngal zhi nas bla ma de nyid la ma dmigs so// 'bri klung gi ltong sgra na bzhugs dus su/ tre rag tag gi bar dben bya bar sgom chen gcig gis gsol ba btabs pa'i snang ba la/ rin po che byon nas chos gsungs nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin du yal nas thal gsungs// mtshur phu dgon pa na bzhugs dus su/ tre bo sgom chen gcig nad kyi shin tu sdug bsngal nas bla ma la gsol ba btabs pa la/ de nyid du byon nas zhabs dbang mdzad pa la/ des phyag 'tshal bar brtsams pas/ phyag 'tshal mi dgos dang khyod la nad kyis bar chad mi 'ong gsungs nas 'ja' bzhin du yal nas gshegs skad// de la sogs pa gzhan kyi gsol ba btabs pa'i sar nye ring med par 'byon pa la grangs med do// yang rin po che la/ dge bshes sum pas dgyes rdor du gzigs/ slob dpon dbra ston gyis/ 'od kha dog lnga re mos gzigs/ slob dpon sangs rgyas kyis/ zhal gcig ma'i byin rlabs zhus dus su/ zhal nas 'od 'phro zhing nam mkha' la bzhugs pa gzigs/ phyis 'das nas kyang zhal yang mthong*// rin po che 'gro don la yul khams nas dbus su byon pas/ stod lung mtshur phu'i dgon pa lha lung na bzhugs dus su/

dpyid zla ra ba'i nyin gcig rin po che'i zhal nas/ mdang ni rgya gar gyi dur khrod gcig na/ rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa'i 'ga'i tshogs gral du phyin pa rmis gsungs/ de dang dus mtshungs par gtsang la stod thang cung ces bya ba'i gtsug lag khang na/ gtsang pa ston pa gcig thang ba drub cing 'dug tsa na/ de'i snang ba la a tsa ra ras rkyang pa gyon pa lag na thod pa thogs pa gsum dang*/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa ras rkyang pa gyon pa rkang rjen du 'dug pa/ lag na ka ba li dang*/ sba ber ma lcags thogs pa dung gi rna rgyan yod pa lo drug cu lon pa'i tshod gcig dang bzhi byon/ de nas bod de dang ston pa gnyis bla bo mang du byas/ khyed gang nas byon dris pas/ nged rdo rje gdan nas 'ongs/ kha che nas pu rang ltar lam phyungs gsungs/ rgya gar la ci la byon dris pa la/ rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod la phyin zer/ 'o na bya lo'i mchod pa'i dus su grub thob mang po 'byon ba yin zer na/ khyed dang 'ga' re mjal lam zhus pas/ nged kyis 'di ltar thos gsungs/ de'i dus su rgya gar lho phyogs dza lan dha ra zhes bya ba'i grong khyer na/ rgyal po zla ba rnam par gnon pa zhes bya bas/ ha ha sgrogs pa'i dur khrod du tshogs kyi 'khor lo byas nas/ grub thob kyi rnal 'byor mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba rnams la gsol ba btabs pa la/ rgya gar gyi grub thob bzhi byon/ grub thob chen po mi ta 'dzo gi na re/ bod kyi grub thob gnyis dang drug byon gsungs/ rgya gar dang bod kyi grub thob gang gang lags dris pas/ rgya gar kyi in tra bod de/ dza lan dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ shing lo pa dang bzhi yin/ bod kyi gnyis ni dhar rma 'gir ti dang*/ dha rma shri la gnyis yin gsungs/ de gnyis ci tsug lags zhus pas/ dha rma shri la ni chos kyi tshul khrims bya ba yin te/ 'chi med grub pa'i dngos grub gdam ngag yod pa gcig yin te/

mnga' ris stod na bzhugs/ lha khang gcig mdzad pa la brten nas sems can mang po'i don mdzad/ shri dhar rma 'gir ti ni/ bod skad du dpal chos kyi grags pa bya ba yin te/ lam rtsa dang rlung la brten te phyag rgya chen po la gcig chod kyi gdam ngag yod pa gcig yin te/ bod yul gyi smad na bzhugs/ mtshan yongs su grag pa ni/ bla ma dbu se zhes bya ba de yin pa 'dra bas/ nged kyang der 'gro ba yin gsungs/ gtsang pa ston pa'i zhal nas/ bla ma dbu se de sku snyan pa shin tu che bas nga yang der 'gro bsam pa la/ sku nas su byon gshegs pa'i dus yin zer bas chos mi tshar gyis dogs pas/ 'gro 'dug gang yang ma red the tshom dang bcas par gyur to// zhes byas pa la/ rnal 'byor pa de'i zhal nas/ bzang spyod smon lam ma gzigs sam/ gzhan yang gdul bya gang zhig gcig tsam gyis// don du thub pa skal par bzhugs// de'ang myur du smin mdzad de// drod gsher ldan ba'i myu gu bzhin// zhes bya ba yin te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can gyi don la gzhan kyis gsol ba btabs na/ skal par yang bzhugs par bshad pa yin gyis/ mos gus dang mi 'bral bar gyis la myur du song dang*/ ci nas kyang chos tshar du 'ongs gsungs/ de nyid du dga' ba khyad par can skyes nas rnal 'byor pa de la yang dag pa'i gdam ngag gcig zhu byas pas/ rnal 'byor pa de bzhengs nas thal bas/ a tsa ra gcig gi tsa nas/ gro ba la yig ge bris nas shog dril byas pa cig blangs nas ston pa la bshad pas/ dad pa khyad bar can skyes nas de'i dpe de'ang byin nas/ 'di rnams bzhi rgyud grol dang byin rlabs nus 'don gyi gdams ngag bya ba shin tu zab pa yin bas/ mi la mi bstan par zungs gcig dang*/ phyis kyang nga dang 'phrad ste 'ong gsungs nas/ bka' rgya dam par mdzad/ de nas ston pa brang khang du song nas/ phyir nang chos ston drangs ces byas nas phyir nang bos tsam na/

lha gnyer na re/ khye rang song ba yi ting la rnal 'byor pa kun yang song zer/ der phyogs kun tu mi btangs nas drir bcug pa la thos mthong med de/ de lta bu 'dri mas ma myong thams cad smra skad/ ston pa nges shes khyad par can skyes nas/ dbus na mar bla ma de'i drung du 'ongs pa'i chis stogs byas nas khyi lo'i dbyar zla 'bring po la stod lung mtshur phu'i dgon par byon/ de nas bla ma rin po che la dbang dang byin rlabs dang gdam ngag zhus nas/ dbyar 'tshams mdzad cing bsgrub pa mdzad/ nam sla ston ka sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams bla ma nyid kyis gra pa 'ga' re la thar thor tsam bshad nas gda' skad pa la/ gong gi rnal 'byor pa bzhi po 'dir byon nam zhu dgos snyam ba la khyod kyis ding sang tsam byas pas chog gsungs nas der zhu ma spobs so// phyis gtsang pa ston pas da ni nges par the tshom med par bya dgos snyams nas/ khams pa'i gra pa dpon grags sing gi khyim du tshogs gcig bshams nas/ rje btsun ba gdan drangs nas/ bla ma stag de'u ba/ dge bshes dkon mchog seng ge/ bsgom ba tshul khrims rgyal po la sogs pa/ gra pa rgan shos bcu tsam bos nas/ de'i tshogs gral du rin po che la sngar gyi mjal lugs de rnams gsung bar zhu ba'i gsol ba drag tu btabs pa la/ rje btsun gyis gong gi mjal lugs rnams ston pa dang mthun par 'dzub tshugs su gsungs pas/ thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to/ de nas a tsa ra gsum po ci tsug lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ in tra bod de dang*/ shing lo pa dang*/ nag po spyod pa ba dang gsum yin/ khyod la gdam ngag bshad mi de nga yin/ gdams ngag de rnams bzhi rgyud grol byin rlabs nus 'don bya ba yin te/ slob dpon in tra bod de la zhus pa yin te/ rgya gar du tshogs 'khor byas pa'i tshogs dpon ni nag po spyod pa ba yin/ khyod skye ba bzhir nga'i slob ma yin/ da res dang lngar mjal/

the tshom gcad nas sgoms la gzhug pa'i phyir phyin pa yin/ chos nyan bshad byed pa yang bzang po yin te/ chos brgyad kyi zhad gcig yod/ khyod bsgom du 'ongs pa legs/ da res ma mjal na nyan bshad la 'byams nas 'gro gsungs/ bla ma stag de'u skye ba bzhir ci ltar mjal zhus pas sngon rgya gar na gar ba rat+na shri bya bar skyes dus nga la sems bskyed zhus pa'i slob ma yin/ de'i rjes la gling 'di nyid kyi byang phyogs dhe ba na bya bar skyes pa'i dus na nga'i mkhan bu yin/ de nas lus 'phags por me tog pa shes rab bzang por skyes chos drug prad dzña'i gdams ngag bya ba mnyan/ skye ba 'di yi gong mar rgya gar mtha' 'khobs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bram ze rgyal ba shes rab bya bar skyes/ ngas dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ bstan bcos la'ang mkhas/ sgoms la'ang bag chags bzhag pas da lta bsgoms pa la nges shes skye sla bar byung ba yin gsungs/ yang bla ma stag de'u bas/ rje btsun bas sprul pa du ma mdzad pa yin bar 'dug na/ ding sang 'jig rten gyi khams na sprul pa du bzhugs zhus pa las/ rje btsun kyi zhal nas/ lar nges pa med de 'on kyang sprul pa bzhis sems can gyi don byed pa 'dra gsung*/ sprul pa de kun gang na bzhugs zhus pa la/ mnga' ris kyi pha rol kha che'i tshu rol gcig na/ pu rigs bya ba'i grong khyer cig na/ sngar gyi slob ma 'dan chung ba shi ba der skyes pa'i don du dge slong dge ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba sems can gyi don byed/ yang bal bod gnyis kyi 'tshams lan de bya ba na/ bla ma bhe ro'i dgon pa na/ rten dge bsnyen mtshan chos kyi grags pa bya ba/ chos brda'i tshul du gsungs nas sems can yi don byed/ rgya gar lho phyogs na rten rnal 'byor pa yin snang ba dag pas thugs rje chen por yang gzigs/ la las thugs rje chen po rang yin zer ba yang yod/ lar nges med du bzhugs/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na/

grub thob rgyal po'i cha byad can grags pa mtha' yas zhes grags/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ rgyal khams de rgyal po min pas mi thul ba yin te/ des 'gro ba mang po la phan ba yin gsungs/ rje btsun kam po gnas nang na bzhugs dus su/ dpon yon bdag rgon pa bas lha gang gi rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/ me tog la rten 'brel zlo ba'i skabs su/ de'i gnyer pa dpon sgoms rdor bya ba'i snang ba la/ me tog ni nas rang 'thor la/ 'gro zhing rten kun la phog pa mthong nas gzhan la bstan pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to// yang gnas nang gi lho phyogs nyi ma gsum gyi so na/ dge bshes shākya bya ba bal po dhas ru dkar po'i slob ma// nā ro pa'i yang slob kyi rnal 'byor pa chen po gcig gis/ rin po che rab gnas la spyan drangs nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/ skye bo pho mo thag ring ba kun kyis snang ba la lha khang la me 'bar bar mthong*/ thag nye bas lha khang 'khor bar mthong*/ nang na yod pa'i yon bdag la sogs pa kun kyi rten thams cad 'gul ba dang sgra grag par tshor/ khyad par du rdo rje sems dpa'i lugs sku chen po gcig gis phyag g.yon pa'i srin 'dzub kyi rtse mo na/ phyag mtshan rdo rje yod pa sngar lugs kyi dus na yo bas srang thabs med pa gcig te drang por gyur pa la thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to// yang gnas nang gi shar phyogs nyi ma bzhi'i sa na/ 'dzam yul kham kar bya ba na/ me ge dge bshes jo sras kyi rab gnas la gdan drangs pa'i dus su/ rten 'brel bzla ba'i skabs su/ dge bshes de'i snang ba la/ maṇ+ḍal steng gi me tog mchan khol ba ltar byung nas/ yar zhing rten kun la phog nas me tog chag pa kun kyis mthong nas/ thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to// dge bshes des rin po che la pha rol du phyin pa'i sa lam dang sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod do// spyir gzhan snang la me tog rang 'thor la 'gro nas/

rten la chags pa dang*/ rten g.yo 'gul byed pa dang sgra grag pa dang*/ 'od byung ba la sogs pa brjod kyis mi langs/ zha bo dang sgur po la sogs pa phyag lcags brgyabs pas zha rangs pa dang*/ lkugs pa gtam gyis gsungs nas lkugs kha bye ba dang*/ mi ma yin ba'i gnod pas zin pa la/ gtor ma btang ba dang bden pa bdar bas phan pa byung*/ de ltar dngos 'dzin can rnams kyi snang ba bsgyur nas/ tshe 'di yi bya ba btangs nas/ yang dag pa'i lam la 'khod pa ni brjod kyis mi lang ngo*// rten 'dre can brgya rab gnas byed pa dang*/ mdze po dang nyams pa can brgya dbang bskur yang*/ rin po che la 'grib mi 'ong ba ci tsug lags zhus pa la/ rin po che'i zhal nas gnyis 'dzin gyi blo dang bral/ chos thams cad du ma ro gcig tu rtogs nas/ gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa'i ngang la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ dngos por gyur pa'i grib dang grib 'byung ba'i yul gnyis med gsung mtshur phu dgon par lo lnga bzhugs nas/ byi ba lo'i ston zla ra ba'i nya se'i nya la/ bla ma lha rje'i 'das mchod byed dus su tshogs sogs mdzad nas/ dwags po gdan sar gser gyi glegs bam bco brgyad/ shog skya po ti bcu gnyis te dum pa sum cu/ g.yu mar 'dzam gling grags shing srang nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mdzad/ spyir gsung rab dum pa brgya/ nor sna mang po ste dgon kun la phul nas/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'tshogs pa kun la gsung btangs pas/ ngas 'dren byed pa yin bas da 'tshogs pa skyong ba mi 'ong bas/ khyod khams su 'gro 'dod pa kun khams su bzhud/ dwags por 'gro 'dod pa kun dwags por bzhud/ nyan par 'dod pa kun skyi shod du bzhud gsungs/ res ni bla ma nyid khams su bzhud gsungs/ res ni bla ma nyid dwags po gdan sar bzhud gsungs/ res ni mon bod 'tshams su bzhud gsungs/ khams su mos pa la las ni bla ma khams su bzhud zer/

la las ni bla ma dwags por bzhud nges zer nas the tshom du gyur pa las/ zla ba gsum du nam mkha' la 'ja' dang sa g.yo ba dang 'ur thug gi sgra la sogs pa ltas chen po rgyun mi 'chad par byung ba la nye gnas dang gra pa rgan po kun na re/ rin po che gnas nang na khams ma bde ba'i dus su zhus pa la/ bla ma mi la'i sku tshe tsam gcig thub gsung ba'i zhal bzhes yod pa yin bas/ bla ma dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum bzhir byon bas da gshegs dogs yod zer/ de nas dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la/ glang gi lo/ lo sar pa stag gi zla ba'i tshes gsum la/ rin po che sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdus nas mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs so// ༈ //der tshes bcu la gdung bzhus pa la/ mthong snang du ma byung ste/ der 'tshogs pa thams cad mthong snang mthun bar nyi ma sngar bas gnyis 'gyur kyis ring bar byung*/ la las nyi ma'i tshogs bcu gsum dang*/ bdun dang*/ brgyad du mthong*/ la las ni nyi ma'i tshogs 'du zhing dgyes par mthong*/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rma bya'i gdugs 'dra ba dang*/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rus pa'i rgyan can kyi nam mkha'i khams gang bar mthong*/ mdo smad pa khyung po lo tsas yang dgon khang thog tu me tog gi char bab par mthong*/ gdung gi steng na 'ja' tshon gyi gdugs brtsegs mang po snang ba dang*/ me sgra la ngos bzung med pa'i sgra snyan sna tshogs grags pa dang*/ dud pa 'ja' tshon du gyur pa'i nang na bla ma bzhugs pa mthong*/ dud pa la bya bye'u mang pos bskor ba byed pa dang*/ bya rgod dang*/ ri dwags kyi tshogs mang po lhags pa la sogs pa'i mthong snang du ma byung ngo*// sngar dge sbyor med pa la dge sbyor byung ba dang*/ dge sbyor yod pa kun la bogs 'byung ba dang*/ sgom chen kun la ting nge 'dzin ngo mtshar can byung ngo*// de nas sems can la brtse ba'i thugs dang*/ dam chos gsungs pa'i ljags dang*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis 'byongs pa'i ring srel dang*/

bskyed rims brtan ba'i sku la sogs pa byon pa rnams la/ bu slob rnams la cung zad re byin nas/ gzhan rnams la dpal mtshur phu mdo bo dgon par sku'i 'dra 'bags dang*/ gdung khang chen po dang*/ gser gyi mchod rten dpal ldan 'bras phung gi bzo lugs bzhengs cing*/ rab gnas rang chas su bzhugs te byin rlabs kyi mthar thug pa byung ngo*// rin po che'i rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa las/ gzhan snang gi le'u ste lnga pa'o// ༈ //shar gling dge slong chen po dang*/ dha rin pu ras sems bskyed pa// u rgyan 'gar ba u ti ta// ban glang spyod du dhar rma shri/ nub gling glang chen rgyal po btul// ka ling rgyal po zla ba gnon// chu klung pad rgyan dge slong mdzad// shar gling bu mo shes rab bzang*// shar gling rad na shi la'o// tre yul yab yum dge 'phel dang*// sgom ba rged po la mthu zhus/ bla ma bhe ros gdams pa gnangs// dpal ldan lha mo dngos grub mthong*// dgra shi gtang rag rta rgyug byas// ska brag gnas su rab tu byung*// bkra ra ba la dam chos gsan// stod lung rgya mar spyan sngar byon// shar ba pa'i gdam ngag thob/ sa phug pa la bsnyen pa rdzogs// dpal chen rga lo a sing bsten// sgom tshul sgrol ma dkar mor gzigs// bla ma lha rje sgom chung mjal// rje btsun ras chung man ngag zhus// spen phug yang khang ba dang mjal/ gshen dang ra ljags dngos su bsten// 'ol kar mkha' 'gros 'tsho ba drangs// lha rje dgyes pa'i rdor rjer gzigs// mon du stag gis skor ba byas// phag ri khar ni thog zlog pa// la stod dge tshul spun dang mjal/ bya bzang bsgoms pas yon tan 'phel// sha med gangs kar bsnyen bkur bgyis// snye mor lam du mkha' 'gros mchod// bla ma rdzong pa'i gdams pa zhus// rdzong chung gsum gyis lha rje gzigs// gru bzhir phag mo zhal gnyis ma// yang der sbrul gyis mid pa rmis// ngos bzang ring srel mang po byon// byang lam dha ma ru phyir byon// gnas nang dgyes rdor lha dgu gzigs// yang der dgyes rdor yab yum mthong*// pom phug phag mo mkha' spyod ma// sgrol ma dkar mo de bzhin no// rdo rje gdan du sgom tshul mjal// phag mo phyag spyan stong phrag ma/

lha rje gtso 'khor gsum pa dang*// bdag med lha mo bco lnga pa// slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ 'phags pa mi g.yo yum dang bcas// dga' ldan byams pas chos gsung gsan/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab dang yum// mkha' 'gro me tog 'phreng ba sbreng*// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' mang*// bya skyibs brag la lha rje phrad// sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'khor dang bcas// mkha' 'gro'i pi wang sbreng ba'i sgra/ rab gnas me tog rang 'thor ba// la drug rab gnas shin tu legs// gnas nang mgon po gri gug 'dzin// yang der rje btsun yid la gzigs// kha che trig brtan ngo mtshar ba// kaṃ por gza' yi bar chad bzlogs/ rdo rje dpal brtsegs bran du bkol// dpal mchog rta mgrin lha lnga pa// mdo khams sgang stod gzhan don mdzad// lha lung yi ge drug pa dang*// bya lo rgya gar tshogs la byon// la stod thang cung ston pas mthong*// der yang 'gar bas sems bskyed zhus// de rjes mkhan bu yin bar nges// lus 'phags me tog shes rab bzang*// bram ze rgyal ba shes rab yin// skye 'dir me nyag yul du bstan// mtshal pa'i 'khrug pa dum bar byas// 'bu tan tar ni rgyal po mjal// mdo bor rdo rje phag zhal bzhi// bka' rgya lan gsum btabs pa dang*// ri bo rtse lngar bhe ro mthong*// sgrol ma chen mo zhal dngos mjal// 'khor lo bde mchog dkyil 'khor lo// thugs rje chen po phyag spyan stong*/ 'khor lo sdom pa yab dang yum/ dbang bskur mdzad pas mthong snang mang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdo rje phag mo zhal cig ma/ dpal chen sgra nag dkyil 'khor ste/ sgom skyon sel tse re re byon/ dpal kyi ri la sa ra ha/ mnga' bdag me tri gdams pa smra/ rmi lam mgon po gsal bar gzigs/ sprul pa lan de'i rnal 'byor pa/ mnga' ris gnas kyi dge slong dang*/ rgya gar shar phyogs rnal 'byor pa/ shar phyogs gling na rgyal po'i sku/

'di rtag mkha' 'gro gong du mkhyen/ slob ma rnams la zhal tshems bstan/ sku gshegs cho 'phrul du ma byung*/ gdung bzhus skye bo shin tu dad/ mchod rten 'bras spungs byin rlabs che/ ding sang rgya gar kar ter bzhugs// de rjes lho brag grub par byon// slar yang shar phyogs mchod rten bdun/ byams pa'i rjes kyi seng ghe yin/ bya rkang ri la sgom chung skyes/ kong ka na yul sgom tshul bzhugs/ pad ma can grong lha rje bltams/ de la sprul pa gsum yang yod/ tha mar ni stong du sangs rgyas gsungs/ rin po che'i rnam par thar pa brgya tsa brgyad pa// sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa bdun pa rdzogs so/// /ā+oṃ swā sti/ tshogs rdzogs mchog dang thun mong brnyes/ dus gsum mkhyen cing lha tshogs dpag med gzigs/ rang gzhan gnyis kyi don rnams grub mdzad pa'i/ bla ma rin po che'i gsung bzhin bkod// dus gsum kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo/ thams cad kun la khyad par du 'phags pa/ 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan chen po/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mnga' ba/ yid bzhin yi nor bu rin po che lta bu rnal 'byor yi dbang phyug chen po/ mi'i seng ge chos kyi rgyal po/ dam pa skyes mchog /'gran kyi do med/ sangs rgyas mngon gsum du byon pa*/ dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi zam pa ma chad pa/ gdams ngag gi bka' so ma nyams pa/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ bla ma rin po che gnas nang ba la/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon ba dang*/ da ltar gyi sku ci star 'khrungs pa'i 'khrungs rab zhus pa la/ grub thob skyes bu chen po de'i zhal nas/ 'das pa'i dus kyi skye ba rnam pa dgu/ ma 'ongs pa'i skye ba gsum/ da ltar gyi 'di dang spyir bcu gsum gsungs pa lags/ de la dang po ni lho 'dzam bu gling dang nub ba glang spyod gnyis kyi bar na/ gling phran 'da' ri thang zhes bya bar skyes nas/ bla ma lha rje 'di rnal 'byor pa su ra pa ces bya bar bzhugs pa la/

ngas smon 'jug tu sems bskyed pa zhus gsung ngo*/ gling dha ri thang du sku 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// de'i rting la 'dzam bu gling gi nub phyogs gling zur tar ti ta zhes bya bar 'gar ba'i rigs kyi rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa/ ur ti tar gyur nas slob dpon med de/ ri khrod dang dgon par bsgrubs la brtson pa chen po byas gsungs/ gling zur tar ti tar sku 'khrungs pa'i rab te le'u gnyis pa'o// de'i rting la nub ba glang spyod du/ bram ze'i rigs kyi dge slong dharma a ti ta ste/ gsang mtshan dha rma shri zhes par skyes nas/ bla ma te lo pa la rjes su gdams pa zhus te/ sems can 'ga' la phan btags gsung ngo*/ ba glang spyod du sku 'khrungs pa'i rabs te gsum pa'o// de'i rting la yang nub ba glang spyod du/ da res kyi yon bdag skya dgon pa 'di/ mu stegs kyi sdig spyod kyi rgyal po dha rma shi la bya bar skyes nas/ sems can la gdug cing khyad par du/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa gcig yin te/ de ngan song nas 'don pa'i ched du/ de'i nor glang po che bdun brgya yod pa'i nang du khyad par du stobs che ba'i khyu mchog gcig tu skyes ba blangs te gnas pa las/ lan gcig dmag gi dpung chen po dang bcas pa chen po gcig song ba'i lam du rgyal pos glang po che la zhon nas khyu mchog des brdzis nas bsad pas phyir skye ba 'gar ngas dge ba la bkod gsungs ngo*/ ba glang spyod du glang po cher sku 'khrungs pa'i rabs te/ le'u bzhi pa'o/// /de'i rteng la 'dzam bu gling gi byang mtha' zad pa'i byang shar gyi 'tshams chu klung pad mas brgyan pa zhes bya bar bram ze sa rdza na'i mkhan bu dge slong dha rma kir ti zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs nas/ ri bya skyibs can du slob dpon dhoṃ bhi pa la gsol ba btabs/ nga'i dge slong gi slob dpon ni pan ṭi ta gcig yin te/

da res kyi dge bshes phya pa 'di yin gsungs/ ngas kyang gzhan gyi mkhan po byas te/ nga'i mkhan bu yang*/ dge bshes shes rab brtson 'grub dang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*/ mdog mkhas pa dang*/ me ge jo sras dang bzhi yin/ dge bshes rdo rje seng ge bya ba'i slob ma yin/ da dung yang khong gi drung du skye bar 'dug gsungs so// chu klung pad ma can du sku 'khrungs pa'i rabs ste/ lnga pa'o// de'i rting la rgya gar shar phyogs kyi yul ka ling kar/ rgyal po zla bas rnam par gnon pa zhes bya bar skyes/ de'i slob dpon ni sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ste/ bla ma lha rje yin/ de'i slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen a ba dhu ti ste/ rje btsun mi la yin/ gsang 'dus kyi lo rgyus dang mi mthun/ rgyal po rgya gar lho phyogs kyi dpal ldan 'bras phung gi mchod rten la bskor pa la phyin pa'i lam du nam mkha' la/ sgra gcig grag pa na re khyod kyis da rung dngos grub mi thob par 'dug pas/ phyir log la 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba gyis zer ba thos/ der dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa mang du byas nas/ slar mchod rten la bskor ba mang du mdzad pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ sngar 'gro dus su khyi gnyis phyir 'brengs pas kyang thun mong gi dngos grub mang du thob nas da lta u rgyan du 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma gzhan pas gdug rtsub che ba gnyis su skyes nas yod/ de dus kyi rgyal po'i 'khor dang*/ kar ti ka dang*/ sa smad kyi mi mang po 'di na skyes na yod/ de'i tshe ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ dge bshes rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis la thun mong gi dngos sgrub mang po yod/ da lta med pa ni de dus bsgrub pa'i yun thung yin pas lan/ dus der khyed bcu gsum kyis snga phyir gsol ba thebs ste/ ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*/ yon tan 'od dang*/

yon tan bla ma dang*/ dge 'dun grags dang*/ smon lam bla ma dang*/ dbus na yod la/ tre na'ang gcig yod gsung*/ yul ka ling kar sku 'khrungs pa'i rabs ste/ drug pa'o// de'i rjes la 'dzam bu gling gi dbus rdo rje gdan nas/ nub phyogs u rgyan du bla ma tai lo pa'i slob ma nus pa'i mchog tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa shi la tan ti zhes bya ba/ tshal dang nags na gnas pa yin/ de'i tshings dbang bskur ba'i slob ma bzhi da lta 'di na yod/ rdo rje 'bum dang*/ sgo sngon dang*/ shākya shes rab dang*/ chos dpal yin gsung ngo*// u rgyan du sku 'khrungs pa'i rabs ste bdun pa'o// de'i rteng du shar lus 'phags po'i gling du/ yab rgyal po dge ba bzang po/ yum shes rab chen mo'i sras mo shes rab bzang mor skyes/ gsang mtshan mtsho skyes byang chub bya ba yin gsungs/ bur skyes na rgyal sa 'dzin dgos kyi dgongs pas bu mor skyes pa yin gsungs/ yab yum chung ngu nas shi ste/ bla ma lha rje 'di dge slong dha rma si ti ces par yod pa dang mjal nas/ yo byad mang po bla ma la phul te/ dge bsnyen ma yi sdom ba mnos nas bslabs bya tshul bzhin du bsrungs/ de'i tshe khyed mang po dang nga'i grogs po mang po yang yod/ tshogs gsogs gcig gi dus na/ pha dge ba grags dang*/ ma dge ba bzang mo'i bu khyed spun bdun yod/ dge 'dun 'od dang*/ shes rab bla ma dang*/ smon lam bla ma dang*/ yon tan 'od dang*/ ye shes 'od dang*/ ye shes 'od zer dang*/ gzhan dang bdun ste/ snga ma gsum gyi nga'i tshogs gsogs gi rogs kyang byas gsungs so/ shar lus 'phags por sku 'khrungs pa'i rabs ste/ le'u brgyad pa'o// skye ba 'di yi snga pa la shar lus 'phags por dang lho 'dzam bu gling gnyis gi bar na/ shar lho 'tshams kyi gling g.yogs yongs su grags pa kun kyi ni ma yin/ ra lta pa'am ra tsa pa la ste rgyal po bzang po'i grong khyer zhes bya bar/

yab rje'u rigs dha rma sbas pa dang*/ yum su ma ti bya ba yin/ nga rang su pa ti 'gir ti bya ba yin te/ lo brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi thub/ de na bla ma lha rje dpal kyi sbas pa zhes bya bar yod pa la/ ma hā ma ya dang*/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgrub thabs zhus/ yon tan 'od dang*/ dge 'dun 'od dang*/ ye shes bla ma dang*/ smon lam bla ma dang*/ 'byung gnas bla ma dang*/ rgyal mtshan bla ma dang*/ rtsa ston tshul sing dang*/ tre'i dge bshes dkon dpal dang*/ rdo rje shes rab dang*/ bka' gdams ba cig dang*/ bcu la ngas sgrol ma de bshad/ ngas bla ma lha rje la tshogs 'khor gcig zhus pa'i tshe khyed nyi shu tsam yod de/ dge bshes bka' gdams pa dang*/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ nye gnas gnyis dang*/ dge 'dun grags dang*/ smon lam bla ma dang*/ rdo rje shes rab dang*/ dge bshes dkon mchog dpal dang*/ ston pa tshul sing dang*/ btsun ma gnyis kyang yod pas/ gcig ni sa de na yod la/ gcig ni dbus su skyes/ yon bdag rgan pa ba 'di khyim bdag phyug po gcig gi bu yin pas/ yon bdag byas nas de nas 'brel ka byung ste/ skye ba 'dir yang byas/ phyi mar yang byed/ mkhan po ska brag pas nga'i mkhan po lan gnyis mdzad ste/ skye ba der nga dge slong rad na shi la zhes bya ba yin/ slob ma bka' gdams pa la sogs pa la/ chos dbang gi rabs 'byed bshad pas/ deng sang yang phan thogs ste ngas spyod pa nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin/ dge bshes pa nag pa dang*/ yul bar pa dang*/ gzhan gcig dang*/ gsum la ngas skyabs 'gro dang 'jug pa sems bskyed byas/ gcig gis bslab bya ma bsrungs pas da lta nyid na skyes nas yod/ mkhas chen ni pan ṭis ta yin bas byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang sdom pa nyi shu pa bshad/ dge bshes bla ma 'od ni/ mdo smad sing tshang bya ba der skyes/ rgya gar gyi 'gram yin/

de na kho'i skye ba snga pa'i slob dpon gcig yod// grub thob zer nyan gcig yin gsungs/ gling phran gyi grong khyer ra lta par sku 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// skye ba 'dir ni stong gsum mi mjed kyi 'jig rten kyi lte ba'i lho phyogs 'dzam bu gling gi byang ngos/ kha ba can kyi sa'i smad kyi cha/ yul tre shod gangs kyi ra bar/ yab ros po sgom ba rdo rje mgon zhes bya ba dang*/ yum sga lcam mo ming 'dren zhes bya ba'i sras mtshan dge 'phel zhes bya ba sku bltams nas/ sngon kyi smon lam dang thugs bskyed kyis bskul nas/ sngar yang thub pa chen po'i bstan pa yar gyi ngo ltar dar cing rgyas par bya ba dang*/ gdul bya ba gang zag skal ba dang ldan ba rnams smin grol la dgod par bya ba'i phyir/ dgung lo bcu drug la tre ska brag dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i chos skor chen po der/ yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gi bla mas mkhan po mdzad/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen seng ge grags kyis slob dpon mdzad nas/ rab tu byung nas btsun par bgyis/ mtshan chos kyi grags par btags/ de nas thos bsam la yul dbus su byon nas bla ma lha rje dang mjal nas/ yang dag pa'i gdam ngag zhus nas/ bsgrub pa la nan tan mdzad nas/ rtogs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad/ gzhan yang grub thob kyi bla ma ngo mtshar can dpag tu med pa dang mjal nas/ de rnams kyi bcud gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi don ci ltar bar thug su chud nas/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos sgrubs rnam pa gsum rnyed te yon tan gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang ldan bar gyur to// de lta bu'i skyes chen sprul pa'i sku chen po des/ mthar gyi stod lung mtshur bzhugs te/ kha ba can kyi gang zag skal ba dang ldan ba rnams/ der 'tshogs nas smin pa dang grol ba mdzad do// yul tre shod du sku 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// skye ba 'di yi 'og mar gzhan don gang du mdzad zhus pas/

rgya gar gyi yul ka rna pa na pa dang nub phyogs u rgyan kyi byang shar kar ti ka'i grong khyer na/ yab dhar rma si ti dang*/ yum ma hā prad dzña shi la zhes bya ba'i sras/ rnal 'byor par skyes/ bla ma lha rje grong khyer pad ma can du mngal skyes su mtshan zhi ba'i go cha bya bar skyes/ de'i mu stegs kyi pan ti ta gcig gis shes pa'i bdag po byas/ bla ma lha rjes shes bya'i bdag po byas nas btsad pas/ bla ma rgyal nas mu stegs pa nang pa sangs rgyas par chud/ ming dhar rma ra tsar btags/ de'i mu stegs kyi rgyal po de'i ming ma ha dzi na yin/ grong khyer kar sti ka na pan ti ta bo 'di badz+ra ces pa nang na yon tan bzang po yod pa gcig yod/ bla ma lha rje dang*/ dge bsnyen bsgom ra dang*/ zhi mdzes dang*/ gar ston dang*/ gser khungs ye shes snying po dang*/ ya zi sngon mo dang*/ rgya che chung gnyis dang*/ grags mdzes dang*/ nyag lde ston pa dang*/ rog sgom dang*/ yon tan snying po ste/ rig pa rtul shugs kyi spyod pa nus pa drug yod pa/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po btul ba dang*/ yul kar ti ka'i rgyal po pan ti tas btul ba gnyis dus gcig yin/ bla ma lha rje dang*/ nang pa'i pan ti ta dang*/ mu stegs kyi pan ti ta dang*/ gsum ka rgyal po'i mchod gnas yin/ grong khyer pad ma can dang*/ kar ti ka gnyis kyi bar na/ grong nyung ngu gcig yod de yul phyogs de thams cad mu stegs pa yin pa la/ ma lus pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa byas/ grong khyer gnyis kyi bar na nyin lam gnyis tsam yod/ nga dang bla ma lha rje yang mjal/ yon bdag dgon pa'ang de na blon po gcig gi bur skyes nas rab byung byas/ khyed 'ga' yang grong khyer ka rna par skyes ste/ yon tan 'od dang*/ dge 'dun 'od dang*/ smon lam bla ma dang*/ ye shes 'od dang*/ ston pa tshul seng dang*/ dge 'dun grags dang*/ bdun lhan cig tu rje'u rigs su skyes/ grong khyer gsum yang phyogs gcig gi thabs su yod/

gzhan yang yul phyogs der/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ ston pa byang grags dang*/ ston bsod dang*/ dpon dar ma ra tsa dang*/ shākya shes rab dang*/ sgom sngon dang*/ rdo rje 'bum dang*/ dge bshes rin chen grags dang*/ dbang phyug grags dang*/ 'od zer bla ma dang*/ yon tan bla ma dang*/ dar ma seng ge dang*/ rdo rje brtson 'grus dang*/ byang pa lha bzo dang de la sogs pa mang po skye/ khyed mang rab bla ma lha rje dang*/ mjal rgyu yin pa la ma mjal te/ skye ba phyi ma la mjal nas 'ong gsungs/ u rgyan byang phyogs kar ti kar sku 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste/ bcu gcig pa'o// de'i phyi ma la skye ba gar skyes zhus pa la/ bod yul dbus su lho brag grub pa'i gnas bdun ces par slob ma gcig gi don du skye ste/ yun ring po mi bzhugs/ khyed 'ga' dang der phrad gsungs/ lho brag grub pa'i gnas bdun du sku 'khrungs pa'i le'u ste/ bcu gnyis pa'o/// /de'i phyi ma la skye ba gar bzhes zhus pa la/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na/ rgya gar lho phyogs u tung bya bar/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas ko ka bya ba yod pa der skye/ sa phyogs de na pa ta la zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du/ yon bdag dgon pa ba rgyal por skyes nas/ lam rnal ma der gzod chud/ khyed rnams dang yang der nga dang mjal nas/ gzod nga mi dgos pa mang po yang 'byung*/ 'gro ba gzhan mang ba la yang phan bar 'dug gsungs/ de lta bu'i sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa ni/ sems can gyi las ma zad kyi bar du/ nor bu rin po che lta bur 'byung ste/ brjod pa dang bri bas mi langs ste/ 'dir ni nyung zad tsam gcig mdor bsdus te yi ger bkod pa lags so// rgya gar shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten du sku 'khrungs pa'i/ le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// rdzogs so// sems dpa' chen po'i skyes rab gser gling 'di// gus bcas skyes bus gces spras mdzad cing ltos/

'gal gyur blo rgya chung na bzod par gsol// dge bas 'gro kun rje'i gdul byar shog //na mo gu ru/ dharma 'gir ti yi yon tan dpag med mtha' yas rgya mtsho las// chu thigs tsam gcig mi brjed gzungs su bkod// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri med des// 'gro kun bla ma'i gdul byar gyur nas kyang*/ shes rab dri med chos sku rtogs 'gyur te// ma rig sems can srid mtsho las grol shog /he he// zhus so// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ rang byung ye shes dbyings las rin po che// bdag gzhan don la mkhyen pa'i blo gros rgyas// thugs rje'i 'od zer rnam 'phrul mang po yis// rtag tu 'gro don gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam bu gling dang ba glang spyod kyi bar/ gling phran rin chen zhes byar sku 'khrungs nas// su ra pa yis theg pa mchog la bkod// dam bcas go cha bgos la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam gling nub phyogs gling zur tar ti na// 'gar ba'i rigs ste rnal 'byor a ti ta// bsgrub pa gzhan kyi dring la mi 'jog pa'i// ri khrod dgon par gnas la phyag 'tshal lo// nub gling sku bltams dge sbyong dag pa'i tshul// rjes bzung 'dren pa'i bla ma te lo pa// 'gro ba'i ded dpon dha rma a ti ta// rgyal sras rtse ba can la phyag 'tshal lo// nub gling ba glang spyod du sku 'khrungs nas// khyu mchog bdun brgya'i nang nas stobs ldan ba'i// smon lam chen pos glang chen skur sprul nas/ sdig spyod rgyal po sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzam gling byang shar chu klung pad mas brgyan// sa rdza na la legs spyod tshul khrims blangs// dpal ldan ldom bhis byin rlabs rtul shugs can// dge slong gzhan kyi dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// ka li ka'i rgyal po gza' bral mtshan// ye shes zhabs kyis dngos sgrubs byin rlabs shing*// dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten gus bcas pa'i// lung bstan dngos grub brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro'i dben gnas nub phyogs u rgyan du// tai lo'i byin rlabs nus pa'i mchog gyur pa'i// mtshal gsebs nags gnas shi la tan tra zhes// rnal 'byor dbang phyug skyong la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal po'i bu mo tshangs spyod shar gling pa/

rgyal srid rin chen bdun kyi dge ba'i bshes// rab tu mnyes mdzad thar pa'i dge blo yis// nges 'byung bde legs can la phyag 'tshal lo// shar lho 'tshams kyi gling phran ra lta bar// grags pa'i mtha' can rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso// rigs 'dzin nus pa'i mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// tshe la dbang thob dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir yang mdzad pa rgya chen mnga' ba'i thugs// byang phyogs gangs ri khrod nas 'gro don la/ 'phrin las bsdus dngos bzhi la dbang bsgyur pa'i// bla ma snying rje can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di nas u rgyan byang shar kar ti kar// yab sras mjal ba'i smon lam mthar phyin nas// rgyal sras dha rma si ti zhes byar grags// dam can gdul bya smin la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal sras thugs rjes gdul bya gcig don du// lho brag grub pa'i gnas su sku 'khrungs nas// phan pa zab dang rgya cher gzhan gzigs pa'i// rtse cig gzhan don can la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di nas shar phyogs dga' ba'i zhing khams su// chags med blo gros chen po'i gdul bya rnams// yang dag thar pa'i lam la 'god gyur cing*// snying rje dam can brtan la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan yang khyed la brten pa'i gdul bya rnams/ las rlung nyon mongs drag pos gdungs na yang*// gnyug ma bde chen ngang du ro gcig pa'i// thugs rje'i chu rgyun chen pos bsil bar mdzod// thugs rjes chu rgyun chen po bsil bar shog// /ā+oṃ ang shri dha rma 'gir ti/ badz+ra si ti hūṃ// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i snying po yin/ zhus so/// /chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam par thar pa bzhugs so// zhus so/// /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam thar 'di// dus gsum rgyun tu spyod nas ni// dus gsum sangs rgyas zhing khams su// dus gsum 'du 'bral med par shog /
